candidates.label: Right ovarian mature cystic teratoma (dermoid cyst)
missing_or_uncertain: Lifelong left leg edema and double IVC are congenital and likely unrelated to the ovarian mass

candidates.label: Right ovarian serous borderline tumor
missing_or_uncertain: Tumor markers normal but borderline tumors can have normal markers; edema remains unexplained

candidates.label: Right ovarian fibroma
missing_or_uncertain: Fibromas are typically solid; solid-cystic appearance less typical; edema unrelated

candidates.label: Right ovarian lymphangioma
missing_or_uncertain: Rare tumor; could explain edema if part of a lymphatic malformation, but mass is on the right while edema is on the left

candidates.label: Right ovarian dysgerminoma
missing_or_uncertain: Tumor markers often elevated but can be normal; edema and double IVC are separate congenital findings

response.rationale: The right adnexal mass is most consistent with a mature cystic teratoma given the young age, solid-cystic imaging, and normal tumor markers. The lifelong left leg edema and double IVC are congenital and likely unrelated to the mass, representing a separate lymphatic/vascular anomaly. The differential includes borderline tumors and fibromas, but teratoma is the most common benign ovarian neoplasm in this age group.
